about: The word error rates measured once on the fixtures (VO-51), 2026-10-05, by scripts/voice/measure.py: a check fails at more than two points above them. stt: each device model by language, on the recorded fixtures; round_trip: each voice saying its sample and the product's sentences, heard by the device model of its language (moonshine-tiny-en, whisper-base). Server models (whisper-small, whisper-large-v3-turbo) measured 2026-10-15 with measure.py --server in the speech image (faster-whisper, int8, 4 threads). Moonshine base on the server (moonshine-base-en-server, onnxruntime q8, greedy, 4 threads) measured 2026-10-16 with measure.py --server in speech:0.0.10, beside whisper-small re-measured there (decision 18).
